rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name + zip and worked only within the user’s account. It retrieved order details, confirmed the jigsaw order was still pending, selected an appropriate easier variant (beginner, 500 pieces) that was available, and the tool logs show a proper refund to PayPal. However, the agent performed two order-changing writes (address change for #W9583042 and item modification for #W4082615) without first explicitly restating the exact change and obtaining the user’s confirmation as required by policy. Even though the user asked to make those changes, the policy specifies a confirm-before-write step by the agent. Final information provided was accurate, but the lack of explicit pre-write confirmation fails the pass bar.
